quality_flags.counted: Direct count or ratio of events; no model.
quality_flags.calibrated: Model constants set against stated reference values.
quality_flags.heuristic: Hand-weighted rule; reasonable, not fitted to data.
quality_flags.estimated_from_synthetic_tracking: Worked out from the synthetic 25 Hz tracking feed (rendered from the simulated match; not real tracking, not video).

metrics.name: Pass distance
metrics.formula: Straight line from where the pass was played to where it ended.
metrics.limitations: 2D only: no ball height or curve.
metrics.edge_cases: Passes without an end location have no distance (null).

metrics.name: Progressive pass or carry
metrics.formula: Moves the ball at least 10 m forward and ends at least 25% closer to the goal centre.
metrics.limitations: Counted for failed passes too; the flag says nothing about success.
metrics.edge_cases: Backwards or square moves are never progressive.

metrics.name: Pass difficulty
metrics.formula: Weighted average of capped factors: length, pressure on the passer, forward progress, ending in the final third, cross or through ball, opponents in the lane, angle across the pitch.
metrics.symbols: PD = 100 * sum(w_i f_i) / sum(w_i), f_i in [0, 1]
metrics.limitations: Opponents in the lane are only known for through balls after a tracked run; the term is dropped (weights rescaled) otherwise.
metrics.edge_cases: A pass of zero length scores on pressure and type only.

metrics.name: Expected threat added (xT)
metrics.formula: Threat of the zone where the ball ends minus the zone where it started (12 x 8 grid); a failed pass gives up the starting threat.
metrics.limitations: A smoothed, symmetric grid from the team's first build, not fitted to these matches.
metrics.edge_cases: Moves inside one zone add 0.

metrics.name: Ball speed
metrics.formula: Recorded ball speed of the pass, shot or clearance.
metrics.limitations: Synthetic events: the speed is the simulator's, at release.
metrics.edge_cases: Null when the event has no ball speed.

metrics.name: Chance quality (xG)
metrics.formula: Logistic curve on distance to goal and the angle of the goal mouth, times 0.75 per defender in the shooting cone, 0.85 for a keeper on the line and 0.6 for a header.
metrics.symbols: xG = clamp(sigma(a + b d + c theta) * 0.75^n * k_keeper * k_header, 0.01, 0.95)
metrics.limitations: Calibrated to three reference chances (penalty spot about 0.25, 20 m central about 0.07, 6 m central about 0.56), not fitted to match outcomes.
metrics.edge_cases: Shots without a freeze frame skip the defender and keeper terms.

metrics.name: Should he have passed? (better option)
metrics.formula: Best unmarked, onside teammate: chance the pass arrives x that teammate's xG, compared with the shot's xG. Flagged when at least 0.10 higher and 1.8 times the shot.
metrics.symbols: alt = P(pass) * xG_mate; flag if alt - xG_shot >= 0.10 and alt / xG_shot >= 1.8
metrics.limitations: Thresholds (7 m unmarked, 0.10, 1.8) were set on the five bundled matches.
metrics.edge_cases: Goals are never flagged.

metrics.name: Unfound run
metrics.formula: When a runner was onside then 1.5 m beyond the line with a clear lane, the xG from his last tracked spot; reported when the ball never came and the chance is at least 0.2.
metrics.symbols: xG(runner_end) with defenders between runner and goal
metrics.limitations: Runs carry 6 tracking frames (every 0.5 s), not continuous tracking.
metrics.edge_cases: No defenders between runner and goal counts as one-on-one.

metrics.name: Possession (rolling)
metrics.formula: Team's completed passes over both teams' completed passes in the window.
metrics.limitations: A pass share, not time on the ball.
metrics.edge_cases: 50/50 when neither team completed a pass in the window.

metrics.name: Field tilt
metrics.formula: Team's completed passes ending in the final third over both teams' final-third passes.
metrics.limitations: Final third = the last 35 m; touches other than passes are not counted.
metrics.edge_cases: 50/50 when there are no final-third passes in the window.

metrics.name: Pressure index
metrics.formula: Saturating load of final-third passes, box entries, shots and xG.
metrics.limitations: Weights are hand-set; it measures attacking pressure, not pressing.
metrics.edge_cases: 0 with no attacking actions.

metrics.name: Momentum
metrics.formula: Time-weighted moving average of home pressure index minus away pressure index.
metrics.limitations: Follows the pressure index, so it inherits its weights.
metrics.edge_cases: Starts at 0 on the first event.

metrics.name: Control vs chaos (CCI)
metrics.formula: Rises with passes per possession, falls with turnovers per minute and direct, driven balls. Sign convention: +1 is patient control, -1 is end-to-end chaos.
metrics.symbols: clamp(0.4 - 1.8 (0.5 T + 0.5 D - 0.6 C), -1, 1); T = turnovers/min / 4, D = direct share, C = passes per possession / 6
metrics.limitations: Ported from the team's first build and rescaled; not fitted to outcomes.
metrics.edge_cases: 0 with no events; a long passing spell tends to +1, a turnover-heavy spell to -1 (tests show both directions).

metrics.name: Pass accuracy
metrics.formula: Completed passes over attempted passes (every pass attempt, out of play included).
metrics.limitations: Does not weigh pass difficulty.
metrics.edge_cases: 0 when no passes were attempted (the denominator is shown next to it).

metrics.name: Expected assists (xA) and key passes
metrics.formula: A completed pass whose receiver shoots in the same possession before anyone else receives a pass is a key pass; xA adds that shot's xG.
metrics.symbols: xA = sum xG(shot after key pass)
metrics.limitations: Inherits xG's calibration.
metrics.edge_cases: One shot per pass: a second shot in the same possession is not credited again.

metrics.name: Shots and shots on target
metrics.formula: Shots taken; on target = goals plus saved shots.
metrics.limitations: Blocked shots are not on target.

metrics.name: Tackles won, lost and success
metrics.formula: Won: tackle events. Lost: the player was dribbled past (a successful dribble names him as the opponent). Success = won over won plus lost.
metrics.limitations: The simulator records no other failed challenges, so attempts are a lower bound.
metrics.edge_cases: Success is 0 with no attempts.

metrics.name: Interceptions
metrics.formula: Interception events by the player.

metrics.name: Distance covered
metrics.formula: Positions averaged over 0.2 s blocks and smoothed over 1 s; the lengths of the 0.2 s steps are added up. Steps faster than 37.8 km/h are tracking glitches and left out.
metrics.symbols: sum |p_k - p_(k-1)| over 0.2 s steps with |v| <= 10.5 m/s
metrics.limitations: Synthetic tracking: off-ball movement follows simple rules, so totals are plausible, not real. Without tracking the field falls back to the event estimate (physical_source). Smoothing cuts tight corners (about 3% shorter than raw).
metrics.edge_cases: A sent-off player stops at the red card; stoppages count (players still move).

metrics.name: Distance by speed band
metrics.formula: Each 0.2 s step's length goes into the band of its speed: walk < 7.2 km/h, jog 7.2-14.4, run 14.4-25.2, sprint >= 25.2.
metrics.symbols: band(v) for each step; bands sum to distance_km
metrics.limitations: Synthetic tracking: off-ball movement follows simple rules, so totals are plausible, not real. Without tracking the field falls back to the event estimate (physical_source).
metrics.edge_cases: Rounding to 0.01 km can make the bands differ from the total by 0.01-0.02.

metrics.name: Sprints
metrics.formula: An unbroken spell of at least 1 s at 25.2 km/h or more.
metrics.symbols: count(spells with v >= 25.2 km/h for >= 1 s)
metrics.limitations: Synthetic tracking: off-ball movement follows simple rules, so totals are plausible, not real. Without tracking the field falls back to the event estimate (physical_source). The synthetic players sprint less often than real ones.
metrics.edge_cases: Without tracking: actions faster than 28.8 km/h (event estimate).

metrics.name: Top speed
metrics.formula: Fastest 0.2 s step of the smoothed track.
metrics.limitations: Synthetic tracking: off-ball movement follows simple rules, so totals are plausible, not real. Without tracking the field falls back to the event estimate (physical_source).
metrics.edge_cases: Without tracking: the fastest recorded carry, dribble or run.

metrics.name: Possession (match)
metrics.formula: Team's completed passes over both teams' completed passes, whole match so far.
metrics.limitations: A pass share, not time on the ball.
metrics.edge_cases: 50/50 before the first completed pass.

metrics.name: Passes per defensive action (PPDA)
metrics.formula: Passes the opponent attempts in their own 60% of the pitch, over this team's tackles, challenges lost, interceptions and fouls in that same zone. Lower means a more intense press.
metrics.limitations: Synthetic events have no pressure or duel events, so the action count is narrower than a data provider's.
metrics.edge_cases: Null until the team makes a defensive action in the zone.

not_computed.name: Game scoring systems
not_computed.reason: Out of scope: PitchPulse shows only stats it computes itself, never a game's points or bonus rules.

not_computed.name: Clean-sheet odds
not_computed.reason: Needs a calibrated match-outcome model; not built.

not_computed.name: Half-space occupation
not_computed.reason: Needs continuous team shape analysis; planned on top of the synthetic tracking.

not_computed.name: Defensive line height
not_computed.reason: Planned on top of the synthetic tracking; not computed yet.

not_computed.name: Pressures and pressing duels
not_computed.reason: The synthetic events have no pressure events; PPDA is the pressing measure.

auto_eventing.label: Detected from synthetic tracking, not video
auto_eventing.name: Synthetic tracking-to-event benchmark

baseline.name: Naive baseline: every ball-speed spike is a pass, every change of nearest team is a tackle

pixel_path.label: Rendered synthetic top-down video, not broadcast footage; no real-video model

auto_eventing.caveat: Circular by construction: the tracking is rendered from the same simulated events used as ground truth, so detector and truth share the simulator's assumptions. Synthetic data only; not real tracking and not video.

dataset.note: Synthetic matches from the PitchPulse engine. Invented clubs and players only.

scenarios.demo_storyline: Scripted demo storyline: home club 2-0 up, red card 52', pressure 60-75', away win 3-2 in stoppage time, two missed square balls and an unfound run.
scenarios.chance_model: Unscripted: every goal comes from the engine's own chance model.
scenarios.chance_model_with_beats: Chance model plus 3 decision beats ('should he have passed?' shots and unfound runs), marked scripted:* in the labels.
